title: Version schemas, migrations and cross-language conformance
summary: Make stored and transmitted contracts portable across supported implementations. A schema revision, rule meaning change or migration must have an explicit compatibility policy and cannot silently reuse incompatible assessment or qualification state.
in_scope: Version negotiation, extensions, canonical numeric/time encoding and migration manifests.
Shared fixtures consumable by Python and a second language.
out_of_scope: Deploying or modifying a downstream project as part of this planning ticket without that implementation task.
Treating synthetic checks as evidence of live provider or user outcomes.
implementation: Separate structural compatibility from semantic rule compatibility and define rejection behavior for unknown required features.
Implement forward/backward migration fixtures with preserved IDs, evidence references and historical receipts.
Use the same canonical cases in a small second-language client to verify encoding and observable operation behavior.

acceptance.criterion: A compatible reader preserves declared extension fields and rejects unknown required semantics.
acceptance.verification: Round-trip versioned envelopes through supported readers and exercise explicit incompatible-feature fixtures.

acceptance.criterion: A migration preserves stable matter identities and can be rolled back under the documented contract.
acceptance.verification: Migrate a database containing corrections, unresolved associations and delivery-unknown receipts, then verify rollback or the declared one-way boundary.

acceptance.criterion: Equivalent fixtures produce equivalent canonical hashes and outcomes in supported languages.
acceptance.verification: Compare Unicode, decimal, null, timestamp-offset and ordering cases using both client implementations.

tests: Same instant encoded with different offsets.
Fractional numeric values and negative zero under the declared encoding.
Rule version changes with unchanged JSON result shape.
risks: Structural compatibility can conceal changed interpretation.
Language-specific number handling can alter cache and identity hashes.

reuse.application: Preserve the explicit scope, provenance, qualification, and evidence boundaries in the governing contracts.

evidence: Closed 2026-11-02: SDK 0.1.0.dev21 adds opt-in version/feature/semantic admission, preserved opaque extensions, strict Python/JavaScript conformance and an exact installed SQLite migration manifest. Existing native guards, monitoring 1.0/1.1 and assistant-review 1.0 remain unchanged; physical SQL schema remains 1.

AC-1/AC-3: 203 contract tests passed in 7.950s, including 34 shared compatibility cases, exact native result round-trip/retry, required semantic changes and explicit refusals. Independent JavaScript checks passed 26 canonical positives, 8 exact-source vectors and 53 strict refusals. Python and Node 22.23.2 agree on preserved decimal strings, integer negative zero, Unicode ordering, null and opaque timestamp offsets.

AC-2: 28 migration/backup tests passed in 5.177s. A synthetic episode preserves an actual correction, unresolved proposal and authorized delivery-unknown history. The test-only upgrade rolls back on interruption; committed future format is refused by an older registry. Verified prior backup restoration to a new destination preserves exact rows/history and sends nothing. No new SQL migration or merge of post-backup writes is claimed.

Final code/test commit 67271eb6a8460a50d5cad8a6cd7efe4da26d1a29; pinned full suite at docs-only 892d03053b3f74f9d47f7e6abebe87d517436003: 1566 tests passed in 1307.074s. Final two-round source delta review covered 4/4 selected files with no findings/warnings after repairing the complete earlier codec reviews.

Final offline wheel SHA-256 b2179b6783bb710c7cd0bccbbae2b1b7532a7e4c035501165d049a6926dded42: 209 packaged runtime/schema files match source. All 19 installed checks passed in 220.648s, including both MAT-091 regression files. Checkout JavaScript client is a conformance artifact, not a second native runtime or bundled Python-wheel asset. No host image build, new live call, receiving acceptance, provider qualification or deployment.

Details and exact environment/rollback boundaries: docs/validation/MAT-074.md and schemas/versioning.md. Raw receipts under ignored data/validation/MAT-074/. SQL version equality does not permit dev20/dev21 state to be opened by dev19. MAT-083 remains separate and unresolved.
